t: You're looking at Forbes House, a Grade II listed house at 10 Halkin Street in Belgravia. It matters for being the birthplace of Fergus Bowes-Lyon, born here in 1889. He was a British Army officer and the older brother of Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother. That made him a maternal uncle of Queen Elizabeth the Second. He was killed during the First World War, in 1915.
